senses.gloss: m. (דלל, cmp. דִּלְדֵּל) anything irregularly wound, tangle; tow, oakum &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 2:1">B. Kam. II, 1</cite> <he>היה ד׳ קשור וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. a. Var. noticed in comment. <cite ref="D00829"><he>דֳּלִי</he></cite>) if the cock’s feet were entangled &c.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 19b:10">Ib. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>בעל הד׳</he> the owner of the tangled material.
